text: Call Issued: May 11, 2017 Call Closed: June 21, 2017 Number of Addenda Issued: Not Applicable Number of Bids: Twenty-Nine (29)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (March 13, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: NJPA RFP Number 062117-VRM Description: For the Supply and Delivery of Five (5) Various Grounds Maintenance Equipment in 2018 with option to purchase Eight (8) units in 2019, Eight (8) units in 2020 and Eight (8) in 2021, pending budget availability. If the contract is extended for a fifth year (at the discretion of the National Joint Power Alliance), Fleet Services may purchase Eight (8) units in 2022.
